born.why: The code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between critical starvation (eat anything), known poisons (leave), and safe foods (carry if well-fed, eat if hungry). For unknowns, it uses 'taste' to gather data safely unless hunger is too high to wait, ensuring long-term learning and efficient foraging.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding confirmed poisons and carrying safe fruits for efficient energy storage, while using tasting to safely explore unknown species until sufficient data exists to classify them as safe or toxic.

The code prioritizes survival by eating known safe fruits when hungry and carrying them to the pantry when sated for future use, while cautiously tasting unknown fruits only if health permits, leaving known poisons, and resorting to eating anything only in critical starvation.

The code prioritizes survival by eating when extremely hungry, uses a weighted scoring system to distinguish between species-specific and trait-based learning, carries safe food to build reserves for future famine, and tastes unknown fruits only when hunger justifies the risk or curiosity.

This code prioritizes survival by checking for starvation first, then using diary history to avoid known poisons and exploit known safe foods, switching between eating (for immediate relief) and carrying (for efficiency) based on hunger levels, and defaulting to tasting for unknown species to gather information safely.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly avoiding known poisons and trait-similar threats, eating only when starving or safe, tasting unknowns to expand knowledge, and carrying surplus food when not critically hungry.

The code prioritizes survival by eating only when starving (>90 hunger), uses a diary to permanently avoid poisonous fruits, and distinguishes between safe (carry/eat) and unknown (taste/learn) fruits to build long-term foraging knowledge without unnecessary risk.
